summary.headline: Calendrical Cycles and Eras
summary.text: Discussion of calendrical eras and cycles, including the duodenary and sexagenary cycles, competing chronologies for the creation of the world, and Persian, Turkish, Cathayan, and Brahmin systems of reckoning. Muhyi al-Din Maghribi’s Zij of Awar al-Anwar, Yazdgerd dating, Siyaq registers, solar-year divisions, and twelve lunar months are cited.
